description: Radio + GPS timeline for Timisoara mobility; target = imminent serving-cell change (handoff_next).

speed_kmh.description: Instantaneous speed from the GPS trace.

is_peak_hour.description: 1 if hour in peak window (see config.yaml).

netmonster_location.description: Raw NetMonster location string ('-' if absent).

radio_cell_index.description: Index of the cell within the session radio sequence (collection artifact; excluded from Stage 2 model).

session_id.description: Measurement session identifier (grouping key for validation).

hour.description: Hour of day (0-23), derived from timestamp.

handoff.description: 1 when the serving cell (CID) or PCI changes vs the previous sample.

handoff_next.description: TARGET: 1 if a handoff occurs within the next horizon_s seconds (default 15 s).

dl_mbps.description: Speedtest download throughput (sparse, tolerance-joined; EDA only).

speedtest_matched.description: 1 if a Speedtest measurement was matched to this row.

engineered_features.note: Computed by src/features/sequential_features.py for the Stage 2 model; causal, per-session.

rolling_mean_speed_15s.description: Rolling mean speed over last 15 s.

rolling_std_speed_15s.description: Rolling std of speed over last 15 s.

handoff_history_30s.description: Number of handovers in the last 30 s.

handoff_history_60s.description: Number of handovers in the last 60 s.

dwell_time_s.description: Seconds since the last serving-cell change in the session.

unique_pci_last_60s.description: Distinct PCIs seen in the last 60 s (cell-edge indicator).
